item.title: Slave descendant criticizes Smithsonian's 'woke' anti-American narrative
item.description: Bishop Earl Walker Jackson, whose ancestors were enslaved, condemns the Smithsonian's American history exhibits as promoting anti-American indoctrination.

item.title: AOC Considers Egg Freezing Amid Presidential Speculation
item.description: Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez revealed plans to freeze her eggs, calling it a potential 'political risk,' just hours before a major announcement.

item.title: Trump Reiterates Reflecting Pool Vandalism Claim with New Witness
item.description: Trump shared court documents citing a National Park Service employee alleging David Hearn 'violently' damaged the Reflecting Pool.
